verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י יִשָׂשכָ֗ר תּוֹלָ֧ע וּפוּאָ֛ה יָשִׁיב וְשִׁמְר֖וֹן אַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê yi·śā·š·ḵār tō·w·lā‘ ū·p̄ū·’āh yå̄·šīḇ wə·šim·rō·wn ’ar·bā·‘āh
verses.literal: The sons of Issachar Tola Puah Jashub and Shimron four in all
verses.literalPt: Quanto aos filhos de Issacar, foram quatro: Tola, Pua, Jasube e Sinrom.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י תוֹלָ֗ע עֻזִּ֡י וּרְפָיָ֡ה וִֽ֠ירִיאֵל וְיַחְמַ֨י וְיִבְשָׂ֜ם וּשְׁמוּאֵ֗ל רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־ אֲבוֹתָם֙ לְתוֹלָ֔ע גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֑ם מִסְפָּרָם֙ בִּימֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ṯō·w·lā‘ ‘uz·zî ū·rə·p̄ā·yāh wî·rî·’êl wə·yaḥ·may wə·yiḇ·śām ū·šə·mū·’êl rā·šîm lə·ḇêṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām lə·ṯō·w·lā‘ gib·bō·w·rê ḥa·yil lə·ṯō·lə·ḏō·w·ṯām mis·pā·rām bî·mê ḏā·wîḏ ‘eś·rîm- ū·šə·na·yim ’e·lep̄ wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The sons of Tola Uzzi Rephaiah Jeriel Jahmai Ibsam and Shemuel the heads of their families . . . In the days of David 22,600 . . . . . . . . . . . . descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Tola: Uzi, Refaías, Jeriel, Jamai, Ibsão e Samuel, cabeças das suas famílias, a saber, de Tola; homens ilustres em valor nas suas gerações. O seu número, nos dias de Davi, foi de vinte e dois mil e seiscentos.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י עֻזִּ֖י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֣י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֗ה מִֽיכָאֵ֡ל וְ֠עֹבַדְיָה וְיוֹאֵ֧ל יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה רָאשִׁ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ‘uz·zî yiz·raḥ·yāh ū·ḇə·nê yiz·raḥ·yāh mî·ḵā·’êl wə·‘ō·ḇaḏ·yāh wə·yō·w·’êl yiš·šî·yāh ḥă·miš·šāh rā·šîm kul·lām
verses.literal: The son of Uzzi Izrahiah The sons of Izrahiah Michael Obadiah Joel and Isshiah All five of them were chiefs
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Uzi: Izraías; e os filhos de Izraías: Micael, Obadias, Joel e Issias, cinco; todos eles homens principais.

verses.original: וַעֲלֵיהֶ֨ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֜ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֗ם גְּדוּדֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף כִּֽי־ הִרְבּ֥וּ נָשִׁ֖ים וּבָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·lê·hem lə·ṯō·lə·ḏō·w·ṯām lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām gə·ḏū·ḏê ṣə·ḇā mil·ḥā·māh šə·lō·šîm wə·šiš·šāh ’ā·lep̄ kî- hir·bū nā·šîm ū·ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: In addition to them according to their genealogy . . . . . . . . . they had 36,000 . . . . . . troops for battle for they had many wives and children
verses.literalPt: Com eles, nas suas gerações, segundo as casas de seus pais, havia tropas do exército para a guerra, trinta e seis mil homens; pois tinham muitas mulheres e filhos.

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם לְכֹל֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת יִשָׂשכָ֔ר גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שְׁמוֹנִ֤ים וְשִׁבְעָה֙ אֶ֔לֶף הִתְיַחְשָׂ֖ם לַכֹּֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥê·hem lə·ḵōl miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ yi·śā·š·ḵār gib·bō·w·rê ḥă·yā·lîm šə·mō·w·nîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’e·lep̄ hiṯ·yaḥ·śām lak·kōl
verses.literal: Their kinsmen belonging to all the families of Issachar who were mighty men of valor totaled 87,000 . . . . . . as listed in their genealogies
verses.literalPt: Seus irmãos, entre todas as famílias de Issacar, homens ilustres em valor, contados todos pelas suas genealogias, foram oitenta e sete mil.

verses.original: בִּנְיָמִ֗ן בֶּ֧לַע וָבֶ֛כֶר וִידִֽיעֲאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: bin·yā·min be·la‘ wā·ḇe·ḵer wî·ḏî·‘ă·’êl šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: The three sons of Benjamin Bela Becher and Jediael
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Benjamim: Bela, Bequer e Jediael, três.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗לַע אֶצְבּ֡וֹן וְעֻזִּ֡י וְ֠עֻזִּיאֵל וִירִימ֨וֹת וְעִירִ֜י חֲמִשָּׁ֗ה רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֗ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ḇe·la‘ ’eṣ·bō·wn wə·‘uz·zî wə·‘uz·zî·’êl wî·rî·mō·wṯ wə·‘î·rî ḥă·miš·šāh rā·šê bêṯ ’ā·ḇō·wṯ gib·bō·w·rê ḥă·yā·lîm wə·hiṯ·yaḥ·śām ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·na·yim ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·lō·šîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh
verses.literal: The sons of Bela Ezbon Uzzi Uzziel Jerimoth and Iri heads of their families . . . five in all There were 22,034 . . . . . . . . . . . . mighty men of valor listed in their genealogies
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Bela: Ezbom, Uzi, Uziel, Jerimote e Iri, cinco; cabeças das suas famílias, homens ilustres em valor, cujo número segundo as suas genealogias foi de vinte e dois mil e trinta e quatro.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בֶ֗כֶר זְמִירָ֡ה וְיוֹעָ֡שׁ וֶ֠אֱלִיעֶזֶר וְאֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י וְעָמְרִי֙ וִירֵמ֣וֹת וַאֲבִיָּ֔ה וַעֲנָת֖וֹת וְעָלָ֑מֶת כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־ בָֽכֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ḇe·ḵer zə·mî·rāh wə·yō·w·‘āš we·’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer wə·’el·yō·w·‘ê·nay wə·‘ā·mə·rî wî·rê·mō·wṯ wa·’ă·ḇî·yāh wa·‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ wə·‘ā·lā·meṯ kāl- ’êl·leh bə·nê- ḇā·ḵer
verses.literal: The sons of Becher Zemirah Joash Eliezer Elioenai Omri Jeremoth Abijah Anathoth and Alemeth all these were Becher’s sons
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Bequer: Zemira, Joás, Eliézer, Elioenai, Onri, Jeremote, Abias, Anatote e Alemete. Todos estes foram filhos de Bequer.

verses.original: וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֗ם רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔ם גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חָ֑יִל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·yaḥ·śām lə·ṯō·lə·ḏō·w·ṯām rā·šê bêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām gib·bō·w·rê ḥā·yil ‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ū·mā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: Their genealogies were recorded according to the heads of their families . . . 20,200 . . . . . . mighty men of valor
verses.literalPt: O número deles nas suas genealogias, segundo as suas gerações, cabeças das suas famílias, homens ilustres em valor, foi de vinte e dois mil.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יְדִיעֲאֵ֖ל בִּלְהָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֗ן יְעִישׁ וּ֠בִנְיָמִן וְאֵה֤וּד וּֽכְנַעֲנָה֙ וְזֵיתָ֔ן וְתַרְשִׁ֖ישׁ וַאֲחִישָֽׁחַר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yə·ḏî·‘ă·’êl bil·hān ū·ḇə·nê ḇil·hān yə·ʿīš ū·ḇin·yā·min wə·’ê·hūḏ ū·ḵə·na·‘ă·nāh wə·zê·ṯān wə·ṯar·šîš wa·’ă·ḥî·šā·ḥar
verses.literal: The son of Jediael Bilhan The sons of Bilhan Jeush Benjamin Ehud Chenaanah Zethan Tarshish and Ahishahar
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Jediael: Bilã; e os filhos de Bilã: Jeús, Benjamim, Eúde, Quenaaná, Zetã, Társis e Aisaar.

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ לְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שִׁבְעָֽה־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּמָאתַ֔יִם יֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֖א לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh bə·nê yə·ḏî·‘ă·’êl lə·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ gib·bō·w·rê ḥă·yā·lîm šiḇ·‘āh- ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ ū·mā·ṯa·yim yō·ṣə·’ê ṣā·ḇā lam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: All these sons of Jediael were heads of their families mighty men of valor there were 17,200 . . . . . . . . . fit for battle . . .
verses.literalPt: Todos estes filhos de Jediael, segundo os cabeças das suas famílias, homens ilustres em valor, foram dezessete mil e duzentos, que podiam sair no exército para a guerra.

verses.original: וְשֻׁפִּ֤ם וְחֻפִּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י עִ֔יר חֻשִׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šup·pim wə·ḥup·pim bə·nê ‘îr ḥu·šim bə·nê ’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: The Shuppites and Huppites were descendants of Ir and the Hushites were descendants of Aher
verses.literalPt: Supim também e Hupim, filhos de Ir; … Husim, filhos de Aer.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֗י יַחֲצִיאֵ֧ל וְגוּנִ֛י וְיֵ֥צֶר וְשַׁלּ֖וּם בְּנֵ֥י בִלְהָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: bə·nê nap̄·tā·lî ya·ḥă·ṣî·’êl wə·ḡū·nî wə·yê·ṣer wə·šal·lūm bə·nê ḇil·hāh
verses.literal: The sons of Naphtali Jahziel Guni Jezer and Shallum the descendants of Bilhah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Naftali: Jaziel, Guni, Jezer e Salum, filhos de Bilha.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אַשְׂרִיאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלָ֑דָה פִּֽילַגְשׁוֹ֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּיָּ֔ה יָלְדָ֕ה אֶת־ מָכִ֖יר אֲבִ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê mə·naš·šeh ’aś·rî·’êl ’ă·šer yā·lā·ḏāh pî·laḡ·šōw hā·’ă·ram·mî·yāh yā·lə·ḏāh ’eṯ- mā·ḵîr ’ă·ḇî ḡil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: The descendants of Manasseh Asriel through his Aramean . . . concubine She also gave birth to Machir the father of Gilead
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Manassés: Asriel, que teve de sua mulher (de sua concubina aramita teve a Maquir, pai de Gileade;

verses.original: וּמָכִ֞יר לָקַ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לְחֻפִּ֣ים וּלְשֻׁפִּ֔ים וְשֵׁ֤ם אֲחֹתוֹ֙ מַעֲכָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י צְלָפְחָ֑ד וַתִּהְיֶ֥נָה לִצְלָפְחָ֖ד בָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·ḵîr lā·qaḥ ’iš·šāh lə·ḥup·pîm ū·lə·šup·pîm wə·šêm ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw ma·‘ă·ḵāh wə·šêm haš·šê·nî ṣə·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ wat·tih·ye·nāh liṣ·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ bā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites The name of his sister was Maacah Another descendant was named Zelophehad who had . . . only daughters
verses.literalPt: e Maquir tomou dos Hupim e Supim uma mulher, cuja irmã se chamava Maaca); e o nome do segundo foi Zelofeade. Zelofeade teve filhas.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֨לֶד מַעֲכָ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת־ מָכִיר֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוֹ֙ פֶּ֔רֶשׁ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו שָׁ֑רֶשׁ וּבָנָ֖יו אוּלָ֥ם וָרָֽקֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ ma·‘ă·ḵāh ’ê·šeṯ- mā·ḵîr bên wat·tiq·rā šə·mōw pe·reš wə·šêm ’ā·ḥîw šā·reš ū·ḇā·nāw ’ū·lām wā·rā·qem
verses.literal: Machir’s wife Maacah gave birth to a son and she named him . . . Peresh His brother was named Sheresh and his sons were Ulam and Rekem
verses.literalPt: Maaca, mulher de Maquir, deu à luz um filho, ao qual ele chamou Perez; este teve um irmão, chamado Seres, e seus filhos foram Ulão e Requém.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אוּלָ֖ם בְּדָ֑ן אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד בֶּן־ מָכִ֖יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ’ū·lām bə·ḏān ’êl·leh bə·nê ḡil·‘āḏ ben- mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: The son of Ulam Bedan These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir the son of Manasseh
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Ulão: Bedã. Estes foram os filhos de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés.

verses.original: וַאֲחֹת֖וֹ הַמֹּלֶ֑כֶת יָלְדָה֙ אֶת־ אִישְׁה֔וֹד וְאֶת־ אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר וְאֶת־ מַחְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥō·ṯōw ham·mō·le·ḵeṯ yā·lə·ḏāh ’eṯ- ’î·šə·hō·wḏ wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·‘e·zer wə·’eṯ- maḥ·lāh
verses.literal: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod Abiezer and Mahlah
verses.literalPt: Sua irmã Hamolequete deu à luz Is-Hode, Abiezer, e Malá.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אַחְיָ֣ן וָשֶׁ֔כֶם וְלִקְחִ֖י וַאֲנִיעָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū bə·nê šə·mî·ḏā‘ ’aḥ·yān wā·še·ḵem wə·liq·ḥî wa·’ă·nî·‘ām
verses.literal: And these were the sons of Shemida Ahian Shechem Likhi and Aniam
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Semida foram Aiã, Siquém, Liqui e Anião.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם שׁוּתָ֑לַח וּבֶ֤רֶד בְּנוֹ֙ וְתַ֣חַת בְּנ֔וֹ וְאֶלְעָדָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ וְתַ֥חַת בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim šū·ṯā·laḥ ū·ḇe·reḏ bə·nōw wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ bə·nōw wə·’el·‘ā·ḏāh ḇə·nōw wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ bə·nōw
verses.literal: The descendants of Ephraim Shuthelah Bered his son Tahath his son Eleadah his son Tahath his son
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Efraim, de quem foi filho Sutela, de quem foi filho Berede, de quem foi filho Taate, de quem foi filho Eleada, de quem foi filho Taate;

verses.original: וְזָבָ֥ד בְּנ֛וֹ וְשׁוּתֶ֥לַח בְּנ֖וֹ וְעֵ֣זֶר וְאֶלְעָ֑ד וַהֲרָג֗וּם אַנְשֵׁי־ גַת֙ הַנּוֹלָדִ֣ים בָּאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֣י יָרְד֔וּ לָקַ֖חַת אֶת־ מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḇāḏ bə·nōw wə·šū·ṯe·laḥ bə·nōw wə·‘ê·zer wə·’el·‘āḏ wa·hă·rā·ḡūm ’an·šê- ḡaṯ han·nō·w·lā·ḏîm bā·’ā·reṣ kî yā·rə·ḏū lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’eṯ- miq·nê·hem
verses.literal: Zabad his son and Shuthelah his son Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives . . . . . . of Gath because they went down to steal their livestock
verses.literalPt: de quem foi filho Zabade, de quem foi filho Sutela, de quem foram filhos Ezer e Eleade, mortos pelos homens de Gate, que nasceram na terra, porque desceram a roubar o seu gado.

verses.original: וַיִּתְאַבֵּ֛ל אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֲבִיהֶ֖ם יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶחָ֖יו לְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·’ab·bêl ’ep̄·ra·yim ’ă·ḇî·hem yā·mîm rab·bîm way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’e·ḥāw lə·na·ḥă·mōw
verses.literal: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days and his relatives came to comfort him
verses.literalPt: Efraim, seu pai, chorou-os muitos dias, e seus irmãos vieram para o consolar.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־ שְׁמוֹ֙ בְּרִיעָ֔ה כִּ֥י בְרָעָ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’el- ’iš·tōw wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ bên way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw bə·rî·‘āh kî ḇə·rā·‘āh hā·yə·ṯāh bə·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: And again he slept with . . . his wife and she conceived and gave birth to a son So he named him Beriah because tragedy had come upon his house
verses.literalPt: Ajuntou-se com sua mulher, que concebeu e deu à luz um filho, a quem ele chamou Berias, porque as coisas iam mal na sua casa.

verses.original: וּבִתּ֣וֹ שֶׁאֱרָ֔ה וַתִּ֧בֶן אֶת־ בֵּית־ חוֹר֛וֹן הַתַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ הָעֶלְי֑וֹן וְאֵ֖ת אֻזֵּ֥ן שֶׁאֱרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇit·tōw še·’ĕ·rāh wat·ti·ḇen ’eṯ- bêṯ- ḥō·w·rō·wn hat·taḥ·tō·wn wə·’eṯ- hā·‘el·yō·wn wə·’êṯ ’uz·zên še·’ĕ·rāh
verses.literal: His daughter was Sheerah who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon as well as Uzzen-sheerah
verses.literalPt: Sua filha foi Seerá, que edificou a alta e a baixa Bete-Horom e Uzém-Seerá.

verses.original: וְרֶ֣פַח בְּנ֗וֹ וְרֶ֧שֶׁף וְתֶ֛לַח בְּנ֖וֹ וְתַ֥חַן בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·re·p̄aḥ bə·nōw wə·re·šep̄ wə·ṯe·laḥ bə·nōw wə·ṯa·ḥan bə·nōw
verses.literal: Additionally, Rephah was his son Resheph his son Telah his son Tahan his son
verses.literalPt: Refa foi seu filho, e Resefe, de quem foi filho Tela, de quem foi filho Taã;

verses.original: לַעְדָּ֥ן בְּנ֛וֹ עַמִּיה֥וּד בְּנ֖וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: la‘·dān bə·nōw ‘am·mî·hūḏ bə·nōw ’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ bə·nōw
verses.literal: Ladan his son Ammihud his son Elishama his son
verses.literalPt: de quem foi filho Ladã, de quem foi filho Amiúde, de quem foi filho Elisama;

verses.original: נ֥וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·wn bə·nōw yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bə·nōw
verses.literal: Nun his son and Joshua his son
verses.literalPt: de quem foi filho Num, de quem foi filho Josué.

verses.original: וַאֲחֻזָּתָם֙ וּמֹ֣שְׁבוֹתָ֔ם בֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל וּבְנֹתֶ֑יהָ וְלַמִּזְרָ֣ח נַעֲרָ֔ן וְלַֽמַּעֲרָ֗ב גֶּ֤זֶר וּבְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ וּשְׁכֶ֣ם וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ עַד־ עַיָּ֖ה וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯām ū·mō·šə·ḇō·w·ṯām bêṯ- ’êl ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā wə·lam·miz·rāḥ na·‘ă·rān wə·lam·ma·‘ă·rāḇ ge·zer ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā ū·šə·ḵem ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā ‘aḏ- ‘ay·yāh ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Their holdings and settlements included Bethel and its villages Naaran to the east Gezer and its villages to the west and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah and its villages
verses.literalPt: As suas possessões e as suas habitações foram Betel e suas aldeias; e, ao oriente, Naarã; e, ao ocidente, Gezer com suas aldeias; também Siquém e suas aldeias até Aia e suas aldeias;

verses.original: וְעַל־ יְדֵ֣י בְנֵי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בֵּית־ שְׁאָ֤ן וּבְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ תַּעְנַ֣ךְ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ מְגִדּ֥וֹ וּבְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ דּ֣וֹר וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ בְּאֵ֙לֶּה֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף בֶּן־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- yə·ḏê ḇə·nê- mə·naš·šeh bêṯ- šə·’ān ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā ta‘·naḵ ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā mə·ḡid·dōw ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā dō·wr ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā bə·’êl·leh yā·šə·ḇū bə·nê yō·w·sêp̄ ben- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And along the borders of Manasseh were Beth-shean Taanach Megiddo and Dor together with their villages The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns
verses.literalPt: e, ao lado dos confins dos filhos de Manassés, Bete-Seã e suas aldeias, Taanaque e suas aldeias, Megido e suas aldeias, Dor e suas aldeias. Nesses lugares, habitaram os filhos de José, filho de Israel.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְיִשְׁוָ֛ה וְיִשְׁוִ֥י וּבְרִיעָ֖ה וְשֶׂ֥רַח אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ’ā·šêr yim·nāh wə·yiš·wāh wə·yiš·wî ū·ḇə·rî·‘āh wə·śe·raḥ ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: The children of Asher Imnah Ishvah Ishvi Beriah and their sister Serah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Aser: Imná, Isvá, Isvi, Berias e Sera, irmã deles.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵ֑ל ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י בִרְזוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ḇə·rî·‘āh ḥe·ḇer ū·mal·kî·’êl hū ’ă·ḇî ḇir·zōṯ
verses.literal: The sons of Beriah Heber as well as Malchiel who was the father of Birzaith
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Berias: Héber e Malquiel, que foi o pai de Birzavite.

verses.original: וְחֶ֙בֶר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יַפְלֵ֔ט וְאֶת־ שׁוֹמֵ֖ר וְאֶת־ חוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֖ת שׁוּעָ֥א אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥe·ḇer hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yap̄·lêṭ wə·’eṯ- šō·w·mêr wə·’eṯ- ḥō·w·ṯām wə·’êṯ šū·‘ā ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Heber was the father of Japhlet Shomer and Hotham and of their sister Shua
verses.literalPt: Héber gerou a Jaflete, a Somer, a Hotão e a Suá, irmã deles.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יַפְלֵ֔ט פָּסַ֥ךְ וּבִמְהָ֖ל וְעַשְׁוָ֑ת אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יַפְלֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yap̄·lêṭ pā·saḵ ū·ḇim·hāl wə·‘aš·wāṯ ’êl·leh bə·nê yap̄·lêṭ
verses.literal: The sons of Japhlet Pasach Bimhal and Ashvath These were Japhlet’s sons
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Jaflete: Pasaque, Bimal e Asvate. Estes são os filhos de Jaflete.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י שָׁ֑מֶר אֲחִ֥י וְרוֹהֲגָה יַחְבָּה וַאֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê šā·mer ’ă·ḥî wə·rō·hă·ḡå̄h yaḥ·bå̄h wa·’ă·rām
verses.literal: The sons of Shemer Ahi Rohgah Hubbah and Aram
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Semer: Aí, Roga, Jeubá e Arã.

verses.original: וּבֶן־ הֵ֖לֶם אָחִ֑יו צוֹפַ֥ח וְיִמְנָ֖ע וְשֵׁ֥לֶשׁ וְעָמָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇen- hê·lem ’ā·ḥîw ṣō·w·p̄aḥ wə·yim·nā‘ wə·šê·leš wə·‘ā·māl
verses.literal: The sons of his brother Helem Zophah Imna Shelesh and Amal
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de seu irmão Helém: Zofá, Imná, Seles e Amal.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י צוֹפָ֑ח ס֧וּחַ וְחַרְנֶ֛פֶר וְשׁוּעָ֖ל וּבֵרִ֥י וְיִמְרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ṣō·w·p̄āḥ sū·aḥ wə·ḥar·ne·p̄er wə·šū·‘āl ū·ḇê·rî wə·yim·rāh
verses.literal: The sons of Zophah Suah Harnepher Shual Beri Imrah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Zofá: Suá, Harnefer, Sual, Beri e Inra;

verses.original: בֶּ֣צֶר וָה֗וֹד וְשַׁמָּ֧א וְשִׁלְשָׁ֛ה וְיִתְרָ֖ן וּבְאֵרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: be·ṣer wā·hō·wḏ wə·šam·mā wə·šil·šāh wə·yiṯ·rān ū·ḇə·’ê·rā
verses.literal: Bezer Hod Shamma Shilshah Ithran and Beera
verses.literalPt: Bezer, Hode, Samá, Silsa, Itrã e Beera.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יֶ֑תֶר יְפֻנֶּ֥ה וּפִסְפָּ֖ה וַאְרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ye·ṯer yə·p̄un·neh ū·p̄is·pāh wa’·rā
verses.literal: The sons of Jether Jephunneh Pispa and Ara
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Jéter: Jefoné, Pispa e Ara.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י עֻלָּ֑א אָרַ֥ח וְחַנִּיאֵ֖ל וְרִצְיָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ‘ul·lā ’ā·raḥ wə·ḥan·nî·’êl wə·riṣ·yā
verses.literal: The sons of Ulla Arah Hanniel and Rizia
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Ula: Ara, Haniel e Rizia.

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־ אָ֠שֵׁר רָאשֵׁ֨י בֵית־ הָאָב֤וֹת בְּרוּרִים֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י חֲיָלִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י הַנְּשִׂיאִ֑ים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֤ם בַּצָּבָא֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה מִסְפָּרָ֣ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh ḇə·nê- ’ā·šêr rā·šê ḇêṯ- hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ bə·rū·rîm gib·bō·w·rê ḥă·yā·lîm rā·šê han·nə·śî·’îm wə·hiṯ·yaḥ·śām baṣ·ṣā·ḇā bam·mil·ḥā·māh mis·pā·rām ’ă·nā·šîm ‘eś·rîm wə·šiš·šāh ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: All these were the descendants of Asher heads of their families . . . choice and mighty men of valor and chiefs among the leaders The number of men fit for battle recorded in their genealogies was 26,000 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Todos estes foram filhos de Aser, cabeças das famílias, homens escolhidos e ilustres em valor, chefes dos príncipes. O número deles, contado pelas genealogias para o serviço na guerra, foi de vinte e seis mil homens.
